dynamic_line: Fucking dull.  Caravan patrols were a bit more fun, for a while, but a guy can only eat so much road dust.  Guarding that pile of bricks full of sad-sack pussies who can't even justify surviving <the_cataclysm>?  Well, I dunno.  They're not a bad bunch but I'm fine not working for them now.

responses.text: Why was someone with your skillset guarding a warehouse?  Must've been some warehouse.
What was working for the Old Guard like?

dynamic_line.gendered_line: Good work, and some fun stuff, but risky.  Without a few hands at my side that I trust, I wouldn't take more of their work.  If I had a solid team, though, I'd happily work for Uncle Sam again.
